@@ -144,8 +144,8 @@ The server exposes tools across three modules in `crates/app/src/mcp/` (see `cra
 
 ### 5. Operations & Geometric Features (`tools.rs`, `pick.rs`, `area.rs`, `features.rs`, #180, #312)
 - `list_operation_types {}`: Inspect all supported operation types, parameter schemas, defaults, and compatible tool types.
-- `add_operation { "kind": string, "tool"?: string, "name"?: string, "source"?: string, "params"?: object }`: Add an operation to the active setup. `source` is `"stock"` (the default), a model name, or the name of a placed DXF profile (#1862: 2D milling, plasma and wire EDM kinds only; a kind that needs a solid model refuses a profile by name, and a 3D kind refuses a setup that has only a stock and a profile). `tool` is required except for a kind that mounts no library tool (`list_operation_types` lists `"mounts_tool": false` and a note - today the Wire Contour): omit it there; naming one is refused by the command.
-- **Wire Contour (#532, #1108)**: a 2-axis wire EDM cut of one closed profile (a model's through silhouette or picked edges). Mount a wire EDM first - `load_machine { "path": "<.mch>" }` with an `edm.conditions` table (no library wire EDM exists until #533). Then `add_operation { "kind": "Wire Contour", "source": "<model>", "params": { "condition": "<condition id>", "side": "die"|"punch", "start": [x, y] } }` with no `tool` (fields: `top_z`, `bottom_z`, `condition`, `side`, `start`). `edit_operation` patches `side`, `start` and `condition`. Refusals arrive as tool errors in the command's words: a tool named, no or unknown condition, a condition with no gap or wire diameter; the start hole and the corner minimum are refused at `generate`. Not exercised on a real EDM control: the wire post is #533 and the program gate refuses a wire cut until it lands, so `post` fails by name.
+- `add_operation { "kind": string, "tool"?: string, "name"?: string, "source"?: string, "params"?: object }`: Add an operation to the active setup. `source` is `"stock"` (the default), a model name, or the name of a placed DXF profile (#1862: 2D milling, plasma and wire EDM kinds only; a kind that needs a solid model refuses a profile by name, and a 3D kind refuses a setup that has only a stock and a profile). `tool` is required for every kind where `list_operation_types` lists `"mounts_tool": true` (including `Wire Contour` with a `Wire` tool such as `"EDM-W025"`); only a kind with `"mounts_tool": false` omits `"tool"`.
+- **Wire Contour (#532, #1108, #2011)**: a 2-axis, constant-taper, or 4-axis wire EDM cut of one closed profile (a model's through silhouette or picked edges) or an open run (`side: "left"|"right"`). Mount a wire EDM first: built-in `"Sodick ALC400G"` or `"AGIECUT Classic 2S (template)"` via `load_machine { "builtin": "..." }` (plus `edit_machine` to add `edm.conditions` and any `edm.codes`), or `load_machine { "path": "<.mch>" }` with an `edm.conditions` table. Add a `Wire` tool (`add_tool { "catalog": "EDM-W025", "holder": "none" }`, or a custom tool with `kind: "wire"`, `diameter` 0.02-1.0 mm, `rpm: 0`). Then `add_operation { "kind": "Wire Contour", "tool": "EDM-W025", "source": "<model>", "params": { "condition": "<condition id>", "side": "die"|"punch"|"left"|"right", "start": [x, y] } }`. All fields (`list_operation_types { "kind": "wire_contour" }`): `top_z`, `bottom_z`, `condition`, `side`, `start`, `tabs`, `capture`, `taper_deg`, `burnout_clearance`, `clearance`, `skims`, `four_axis`, `sharp_corners`; `edit_operation` patches any of them. Refusals arrive as tool errors in the command's words: missing or non-wire tool, no or unknown condition, a condition with no gap or wire diameter, or `taper_deg` past `edm.max_taper_deg`; the start hole and the corner minimum are refused at `generate`. Post with `"Generic ISO Wire EDM"` (vertical, skims, constant taper, and 4-axis via `edm.codes`), `"Sodick Wire EDM (Mark 21)"` (vertical 2-axis only; refuses taper and 4-axis), or `"Agie native wire EDM"` (native Agie Classic Cut 2S job on `"AGIECUT Classic 2S (template)"` with condition `AGIE_QN2`, rectangular punch, and 0.25 mm wire; see `docs/user-guide/agie-wire-edm.md`); milling posts refuse wire cuts by name. Neither built-in wire `.mch` ships with `edm.conditions`, and the wire posts are not exercised on a physical EDM control.
 - **Sinker electrode (#547, #1156)**: `electrode_from_faces { "name": string, "picks": [face ids], "undersize"?: number, "condition"?: string, "setup"?: string, "orbit"?: number, "stub": number, "pickup": number }` generates a sinker EDM electrode from the picked faces of a cavity (its level floor and every vertical wall standing on it, `face:0x…` ids from `list_features`, all on one model) and adds it as a document tool. Give `undersize` (mm per side, 0 or more) or `condition` (a machine EDM condition id, read from the setup's sinker EDM; `setup` names that setup, default the active one), not both; `stub` (more than 0) is how far the electrode stands above the cavity's mouth; `pickup` (0 or more) is the offset from the electrode's top to the measuring reference. `orbit` makes it that much smaller again per side. The reply gives the electrode, its `burn` fields (the `add_operation` params of a Sinker Burn of this cavity) a `warning` when the stated undersize is 0 (the electrode is then the cavity's full size, so any spark gap burns the walls past it), and a `note` when an orbit is given. Only an axis-aligned rectangular cavity yields an electrode; refused by name: picks on more than one model or on something that is not a face, a degenerate face, a boss, rib or overhang standing in the electrode's way, a condition with no undersize or no sinker EDM setup, a model whose facets can't be read, and malformed numbers. One undo step.
 - `edit_operation { "name": string, "params": object }`: JSON merge-patch operation parameters (e.g. `stepdown`, `stepover`, `feed`, `spindle_speed`).
 - **Change a lead shape (#2876)**: `add_operation` and `edit_operation` merge object keys, including enum shape keys. Inspect the current shape with `get_job`, or the seeded defaults with `list_operation_types`. To change a linear lead to an arc, give `"params": { "lead": { "linear": null, "arc": { "radius": 3.0 } } }`. Remove the old key with `null` in the same patch. For a nested lead, give `"params": { "links": { "approach": { "lead_out": { "linear": null, "arc": { "radius": 3.0 } } } } }`. Without removal, the refusal keeps the parser error and lists the merged field paths and keys, such as `lead: arc, linear`.
